name: Black-chinned Hummingbird
desc: Black-chinned Hummingbird (Archilochus alexandri): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 301 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The black-chinned hummingbird is an apodiforme bird in the trochilidae family. These birds are found in numerous habitats, including deserts, mountain forests, and some urban areas.
